cohort: Women in Bangladesh who had at least one live birth in the two years preceding the 2014 Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey (n = 3,162).
finding: 51% of the mothers initiated breastfeeding within one hour of delivery, with significant variation observed based on mode of delivery and receipt of postnatal care.
mod_finding: Women who had a caesarean section were less likely to initiate breastfeeding early after birth compared to those who had a normal vaginal delivery.
